purpose: Test whether one fixed occurrenceid per already-vetted six Neotoma Alnus glutinosa pollen datasets has explicit sampleid / analysisunitid permitting a verifiable join to the complete dataset's sample-specific age chronology.

test.choose_one_per_dataset: smallest numerical occurrenceid in original frozen v13 27 metadata candidate rows (never based on age or model agreement)
test.required_source_identity: source occurrenceid, Alnus glutinosa taxonid=1299, pollen dataset id and site id must match exactly; any mismatch is a source failure, not biological absence
test.sample_join: Only exact explicit sampleid or analysisunitid from individually requested occurrence and original FULL dataset same ID. No joins based on equal sample ages, depths, geography or alphabetical order.
test.chronology_join: Only if exact sample object has a chronologyid for its age row, cross-check explicit chronologyid in the same original full dataset. Chronology label units still cannot independently prove calibrated age-depth posterior.
test.output: six source statuses, candidate occurrence ID, dataset/sample direct key inventory, exact sample join count, explicit age chronology IDs if present, all source SHA, and no occupied LGM status

scope_guardrails: Sample and chronology identity are necessary but not sufficient for accepting pollen species-level 21ka occupied host presence
Pollen species-diagnostic morphology, calibration/revision of age-depth posterior and deposition/transport site must be independently checked
A request error is not a fossil absence; no favorable-site replacement after source result
Previous TTF #149 and chocho #59 real other-plant negative host-specific LGM comparison is not touched
No insect genotype or genuinely ancient insect locality was opened
